python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
items=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[92]['confidence']['1']='low'
a[92]['note']='Final glyph is worn; a leftward top flag remains visible.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(items)
for src,row in zip(items,a):
 assert row['item_id']==src['item_id']
 expected={str(j) for j in range(1,src['slots']+1)}
 assert set(row['slots'])==expected
 assert set(row['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in row['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in row['confidence'].values())
 assert row['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(row['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and complete slot coverage.')
print('Items:',len(a),'Slots:',sum(c.values()),'Calls:',dict(c))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
